# The sea: a 10 x 8 m slab, top at the waterline (z 0), 0.6 m deep so the diorama has sides.
# Top: the sea texture (5e80b2 water, 6db7c3 crests, ece8c2 glints; 0.25 m a texel), `sway` in the bake.
# Sides: deep water, 5f3a60. In place: the scene's origin is the sea's centre. Up Z, front -Y.
new
add mesh cube --name Sea --size 1 --location 0 0 -0.3
scale 10 8 0.6
apply
material new SeaSide --base-color 0.373 0.227 0.376
material new SeaTop --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material texture SeaTop base-color textures/sea.png
active Sea
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign SeaTop
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
# the underside is never seen: no splats for it
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export sea.glb
